test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

Janet has / a pet dog / who are / very smart.
solution:
Here, the erroneous part is **"who are."** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the part **"who are."**
 
• The verb **"are"** is incorrect because it does not agree with the singular subject** "pet dog".**
 
• According to **Subject-Verb agreement, **a plural subject takes a plural verb and a singular subject takes a singular verb.
 
• So, we need a singular helping verb **"is"** with the subject** "pet dog."**
 
• The correct verb should be **"is"** to match the singular subject.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 

** Correct sentence **: *Janet has a pet dog **who is**__ very smart.*
